channel.title: Wire — Ruby
channel.description: Ruby from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: RuboCop 1.92 Makes Agents More Welcome
item.description: RuboCop 1.92 is out! Last time I talked about the long road to 2.0. This time the theme is more down to earth, and probably closer to how a lot of you use RuboCop today - AI coding agents. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Hot Cell 1.0: Securing Active Storage in the Age of AI
item.description: Hot Cell v1.0 moves Active Storage’s image, video, and PDF processing out of your Rails app and into a locked-down sidecar container. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Iodine 0.8: A C-Powered Ruby Server Built for Long-Lived Connections
item.description: iodine - HTTP / WebSockets Server for Ruby with Pub/Sub support - boazsegev/iodine (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: scrap4rb: Find the Messy Tests in a Ruby Project
item.description: A small Ruby gem that reads your Minitest tests and points at the ones that are too long, check too little, or fake too much. (1 source: rubyweekly)
